blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Lung segmentation models such as R231 are widely used, but they fail on severe tuberculosis (TB) CT: cavities and consolidations look like non-lung tissue and are left out of the mask. We present LungMend, a post-processing model that corrects such masks using only healthy anatomy. A latent diffusion model, trained on healthy lungs with synthetically corrupted masks, learns to recover the complete lung from the faulty mask and the bone anatomy, without any pathological data or CT intensities. LungMend recovers cavities and consolidations that R231 misses and improves accuracy on expert-annotated slices. Code: https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend
blocks.zh: R231等肺部分化模型被广泛使用,但它们在重度肺结核(TB)CT上失败:腔部和结合部看起来像非肺部组织,被从面具中漏出. 我们介绍LungMend,一种处理后模型,它只用健康的解剖学来纠正这种面具. 一个潜在的传播模型,在健康肺上用合成腐烂的口罩进行训练,学会从有缺陷的口罩和骨解剖中恢复完整的肺部,没有任何病理数据或CT强度. LungMend恢复了R231漏掉的凹槽和整合,并提高了专家说明片的准确性. 代码:https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-03-02.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Lung segmentation is the first step of most quantitative CT pipelines. The most widely used model is the open-source U-Net R231 [ 1 ] , the de facto standard in 3D Slicer. It was trained on a large and diverse set of 231 CT scans that includes consolidation and several other pathological patterns. Yet it still fails on TB, where large cavities and extensive consolidations have soft-tissue density and are excluded from the mask. We observe three recurrent failure modes: (i) loss of large contiguous regions, (ii) erosion along the chest wall where disease is subpleural, and (iii) slice-to-slice inconsistency, since R231 works in 2D and its 3D masks are fragmented along the craniocaudal axis.
blocks.zh: 肺分裂是大多数定量CT管道的第一步. 最广泛使用的模型是开源的U-Net R231 [1],3D Slicer中的实际标准. 它接受了大型和多样化的231个CT扫描器的培训,其中包括整合和其他几种病理模式。 然而,它仍然在肺结核上失败,因为大腔和广泛的整合具有软质组织密度,并且被排除在面具之外。 我们观测到三种重复性故障模式:(一) 丧失大毗连区域;(二) 沿着病情低于胸腔的胸墙侵蚀;(三) 切片对切片不一致,因为R231在2D工作,其3D口罩沿颅骨轴支离破碎。

blocks.en: Related work. Dedicated pathological lung segmentation combines intensity, texture and shape cues [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] , but it needs pathological annotations, which are costly and never exhaustive. Shape-based post-processing, from statistical shape models [ 5 ] to autoencoder priors [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , projects a mask onto a single plausible shape and struggles when large regions are missing. Diffusion models [ 9 , 10 ] have been used to refine segmentations [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] , but they condition on image intensities, which are what misleads the segmenter in diseased lungs. Latent diffusion [ 14 ] makes 3D medical generation tractable [ 15 , 16 ] , and shape diffusion enables 3D completion in vision [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 ] . To our knowledge, no prior work uses a generative shape prior learned from healthy anatomy to correct pathological lung masks.
blocks.zh: 相关工作. 专用的病理肺分裂结合了强度,纹理和形状提示[2,3,4],但它需要病理说明,这些说明成本高昂,从不详尽. 基于形状的后处理,从统计形状模型[5]到自动编码器前传[6,7,8],在大区域缺失时将一个面具投射到单一的可信形状和挣扎中. 扩散模型[9,10]被用于精细分解[11,12,13],但它们以图像强度为条件,这是误导分解器在疾病肺部的原因. 线粒体扩散[14]使3D医疗生成可传导[15,16],形状扩散使3D在视觉[17,18,19,20]中完成. 据我们所知,任何前科都没有使用从健康解剖学中吸取的基因形状来纠正病理肺口罩。

blocks.en: Contributions. • New formulation. We cast lung mask correction as shape completion with a prior learned from healthy anatomy only, so no pathological annotations are needed and the correction does not depend on the image appearance that causes R231 to fail. • Training without pathology. We introduce a corruption model that reproduces the failure modes of texture-based segmenters, which makes it possible to train a correction model on healthy lungs alone. • Disease-independent anchoring. We show that bone anatomy gives a reliable cue for completing large missing regions, since the rib cage is not affected by parenchymal disease. • Validation on real TB. We evaluate on expert-annotated TB cases and show improvements over R231 and shape-prior baselines, including 3D consistency.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 • 新的表述。 我们只从健康解剖学中吸取了先前的教训,就将肺罩矫正作为形状完成,因此不需要病理说明,矫正也不取决于导致R231失败的图像外观. • 无病理学训练。 我们引入了一个腐败模式,它复制了纹理分层器的故障模式,这使得仅对健康的肺部进行矫正模型的培训成为可能. • 依赖疾病。 我们显示,骨解剖学为完成大面积缺失区域提供了可靠的提示,因为肋骨笼没有受到颅骨病的影响。 • 确诊结核病。 我们评价专家说明的结核病病例,并显示比R231和形状前基线有所改善,包括三维一致性。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Given an incomplete lung mask m ′ m^{\prime} (e.g. the R231 output) and a bone mask b b , LungMend estimates the complete lung mask m ^ \hat{m} . A model that has only seen healthy lungs knows what a lung should look like, so it can fill the regions where disease made the mask deviate from that shape. To do this, the lung is represented as a smooth shape rather than as image intensities, which are what misleads the segmenter, and the missing region is anchored by the bone anatomy, which disease does not alter. LungMend is trained in two stages, both on healthy lungs only (Fig. 1 ): Stage 1 learns a compact space of healthy shapes, and Stage 2 learns to recover a complete lung from a corrupted one. No pathological scan, mask or CT intensity is used.
blocks.zh: 由于肺罩不完全(如R231输出)和骨罩b b,LungMend估计完整的肺罩m ^\ hat{m}. 一个只看到健康的肺部的模型知道肺部应该是什么样子, 这样它就可以填充那些疾病使面具偏离这个形状的区域。 要做到这一点,肺部被表现为平滑的形状,而不是图像强度,这是误导分层器的原因,而缺失的区域是由骨解剖学支撑的,疾病不会改变. LungMend分两个阶段接受训练,两个阶段都只接受健康肺(图1): 第1阶段学习健康形状的紧凑空间,第2阶段学习从腐坏的肺部中恢复完整的肺部. 没有使用病理扫描,面具或CT强度.

blocks.en: Data and shape representation. Both stages use the same 57 healthy post-COVID scans from COVALUNG (COVALUNG dataset, Caen University Hospital, France). Each lung is cropped (bounding box + 15 +15 mm), cleaned (two largest components, hole filling) and resampled to 128 3 128^{3} ; the bone mask gets the same crop. Instead of binary masks, we use the signed distance transform (SDT), SDT ⁡ ( m ) = clip ⁡ ( d ⁡ ( m ) − d ⁡ ( m ¯ ) , − C , C ) / C , \mathrm{SDT}(m)=\mathrm{clip}\big(d(m)-d(\bar{m}),\,-C,\,C\big)/C, with d ⁡ ( ⋅ ) d(\cdot) the Euclidean distance transform, m ¯ \bar{m} the complement of m m and C = 20 C{=}20 mm. We write s = SDT ⁡ ( m ) s=\mathrm{SDT}(m) for a complete mask and s ′ = SDT ⁡ ( m ′ ) s^{\prime}=\mathrm{SDT}(m^{\prime}) for an incomplete one. Each voxel stores its signed distance to the lung surface (positive inside), and a mask is recovered as m = [ s > 0 ] m=[s>0] . The SDT is smooth, so it can be compressed and denoised without the isolated-voxel artifacts of binary masks.

The encoder is fully convolutional, with three stride-2 convolutions (total stride 8), so the latent is a spatial grid that keeps the layout of the lung, not a single global vector. blocks.en: 2.2 Stage 2: anatomy-conditioned latent diffusion
blocks.zh: 2.2 第二阶段:解剖学条件下的潜在扩散

blocks.en: Pathology-mimicking corruption. Without pathological ground truth, we create (faulty, true) mask pairs from healthy lungs. For each training lung m m , a corrupted mask m ′ m^{\prime} is generated on the fly with the failure modes of texture-based segmenters: region drop (a contiguous region removed from the apex, base or lateral wall), medial drop , subpleural erosion , cavities (internal holes) and truncation (a lung cut by an oblique plane). Occasionally a leak dilates the mask, so the model also learns to remove voxels. Most corruptions are mild, so the model learns to keep correct regions unchanged, and a new corruption is drawn at each epoch.
blocks.zh: 病理学-模仿腐败. 没有病理的地面真理,我们从健康的肺部创造(虚构的,真实的)面具对. 对于每个训练的肺mm,在苍蝇上产生一个腐烂的口罩m ' m^{\prime},带有纹理分层器的故障模式:区域下降(从顶部,基部或横向墙壁中移除的毗连区域),介质下降,次胸膜侵蚀,腔洞(内部孔)和弯曲(由斜面切割的肺部). 偶尔有漏气会扩大口罩,所以模型也会学习去除阴道. 大多数腐败都是温和的,所以模型学会了保持正确的地区不变,在每个时代都画出新的腐败.

blocks.en: Bone conditioning. When a large region is missing, the mask alone admits many completions. We add information that does not depend on the disease: ribs and chest wall are unaffected by parenchymal lesions and tightly bound the lung. We provide the bone occupancy o o and a distance-to-bone field δ \delta , both pooled to 16 3 16^{3} , as 𝐜 bone = [ o , δ ] {\mathbf{c}}_{\mathrm{bone}}=[o,\delta] (2 channels). Thin ribs largely vanish after pooling, so the smooth δ \delta carries the distance to the chest wall.

blocks.en: Inference and uncertainty. The input mask m ′ m^{\prime} obtained with R231 and the bone mask are cropped, and m ′ m^{\prime} is converted to s ′ s^{\prime} and encoded into 𝐳 corr {\mathbf{z}}_{\mathrm{corr}} . We draw N N latents with DDIM [ 10 ] (50 steps, guided with w w ) and decode each with D ∗ D^{*} into an SDT s ^ ( n ) \hat{s}^{(n)} . The mean of the N N decoded SDTs, s ¯ = 1 N ​ ∑ n s ^ ( n ) \bar{s}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n}\hat{s}^{(n)} , is upsampled trilinearly to the native grid and thresholded at zero, and the two largest components form the corrected mask m ^ \hat{m} . The standard deviation of the same N N SDTs, u ⁡ ( x ) = std n ​ s ^ ( n ) ​ ( x ) u(x)=\mathrm{std}_{n}\,\hat{s}^{(n)}(x) , gives a voxel-wise uncertainty map: it is close to zero where the samples agree, for example where the input mask is kept, and high where they differ, i.e. where several completions are plausible.
blocks.zh: 推论与不定. 用 R231 获得的输入面罩 m → m^{\prime → 骨头面罩被收割, m → m^{\prime → 转换为 s prime → 并编码为 z corr → mathbf{z}}_{\mathrm{ corr}. 我们用 DDIM [10] (50步, 以 w w 引导) 绘制 N 潜伏 , 用 D * * D 分别解码为 SDT s ^ (n)\hat{s}^{(n)} 。 N解码的SDTs的平均值,s = 1 N = n = (n)\bar{s}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n}\hat{s}^{(n)},三线向原生网格上标注,以0为阈值,两个最大组件构成校正的口罩m ^\ hat{m}. 同一N N SDTs的标准偏差,u ⁡(x) = std n s ^ (n) (x) u(x) =\(mathrm{std}_{n}\),\hat{s}^{(n)}(x)  gives(x) 给出一个voxel-wise的不确定性图:当样品同意时,它接近零,例如输入口罩被保存,而其差异高,即几个完成是可信的.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据

blocks.en: Training data. The VAE (Stage 1) and the diffusion model (Stage 2) are trained on the same private COVALUNG cohort: 57 healthy post-COVID patients with no consolidation or other parenchymal lesion (90/10% patient-level split). No pathological scan or mask is used at any point.
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 VAE(第1阶段)和扩散模式(第2阶段)对同一私人COVALUNG组别进行了培训:57名无合并或其他间隙性损伤的健康后COVID患者(90/10%的患者级别分裂)。 任何时间都不使用病理学扫描或面具.

blocks.en: Test data. We use 20 TB cases from ImageCLEF TB [ 27 ] , selected with the DeepPulmo annotations [ 28 ] as the most severe in cavity burden, since large cavities and consolidations are where R231 fails most. Cavities cover 3.1–16.1% of the lung volume (largest cavity 57–962 mL, 4–36 cavities per case) and consolidation 2.0–21.9%. Patient lists and details are provided in the code repository. The DeepPulmo lung masks are not accurate enough to serve as a reference (examples in the repository), so we use only its lesion labels. To obtain a reliable reference, a thoracic radiologist corrected the R231 mask on 200 axial slices, 10 per case. Finally, we assess LungMend qualitatively on TB CT scans of 18 patients from Avicenne Hospital, Bobigny, France.
blocks.zh: 测试数据。 我们使用来自ImageCLEF TB [27] 的20例肺结核病例, 选用深普尔莫注解 [28] 作为腔内负担最严重的病例, 因为大腔和整合是R231最失败的地方. 笼盖占肺体积的3.1–16.1%(最大腔57–962毫升,每例4–36个腔)和整合2.0–21.9%. 患者名单和详细情况见代码存储库. DeepPulmo肺口罩不够准确,无法作为参考(仓库中的例子),因此我们只使用其损伤标签. 为了获得可靠的参考,一位胸腔放射学家在200轴切片上纠正了R231面具,每例10枚. 最后,我们对法国博比尼Avicenne医院18名病人的结核病CT扫描结果进行定性评估。

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate in two ways: • Expert slices: Dice and average surface distance (ASD) on the 200 radiologist-corrected slices. • Lesion recovery: using the DeepPulmo cavity and consolidation labels, the fraction of each lesion included in the predicted lung mask (recall), over the 200 slices. In addition, we assess LungMend qualitatively on the Avicenne cohort.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两种方式进行评估: 专家切片:在200个放射学家修正的切片上,虱子和平均表面距离(ASD). • Lesion恢复:使用DeepPulmo腔和整合标签,预测肺罩(召回)中每一损伤的分量,超过200片。 此外,我们还从质量上评估了LongMend在Avicenne族的情况。

blocks.en: Expert slices: Dice and average surface distance (ASD) on the 200 radiologist-corrected slices.
blocks.zh: 专家切片: 在200个放射学家校正的切片上,凹槽和平均表面距离(ASD).

blocks.en: Lesion recovery: using the DeepPulmo cavity and consolidation labels, the fraction of each lesion included in the predicted lung mask (recall), over the 200 slices.
blocks.zh: Lesion recover:使用DeepPulmo腔和整合标签,在预测肺罩(召回)中包含的每个损伤的分量,超过200片.

blocks.en: 3.3 Baselines and implementation
blocks.zh: 3.3 基线和执行

blocks.en: Baselines. Segmentation models applied to the CT: R231, a U-Net trained on diverse routine CT including pathological cases; TotalSegmentator [ 29 ] , an nnU-Net-based model trained on 1204 CT examinations of clinical routine, with varied pathologies, scanners and sites (lung output: union of the lung lobes); and VISTA3D [ 30 ] , a MONAI segmentation foundation model with a SegResNet backbone, trained on 11,454 CT volumes with anatomical and lesion annotations. Mask correction: R231 with morphological closing (10 mm ball) and hole filling; Post-DAE [ 7 ] trained on the same healthy masks and corruptions; and a deterministic 3D U-Net that takes the CT, the R231 mask and the bone mask and predicts the corrected mask, trained on the same healthy scans and corruptions. It has the same conditioning as LungMend plus the CT, but no diffusion step, which isolates the effect of the generative formulation.
blocks.zh: 基线。 适用于CT的分块模型:R231,一个接受过包括病理病例在内的各种常规CT培训的U-Net;TotalSector[29],一个NNU-Net模型,接受过1204 CT临床常规检查的培训,有各种病理、扫描仪和站点(连锁输出:肺叶结合);和VISTA3D[30],一个MONAI分块模型,一个SegResNet骨干,培训11,454 CT卷,有解剖学和损伤说明。 面罩矫正:R231带有形态闭合(10毫米球)和孔填充;Post-DAE [7]接受了相同的健康面罩和腐败方面的培训;以及一个定型3D U-Net,它带走了CT,R231面罩和骨面罩,并预言了正确的面罩,接受了同样的健康扫描和腐败方面的培训. 它与LungMend加CT具有相同的条件,但没有扩散步骤,这隔离了基因配体的效果.

blocks.en: 4 Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Comparison with baselines. LungMend is the best method on every metric of Table 1 , with the largest margin on HD95 (5.5 mm vs. 22.9 mm for the strongest baseline, R231 + closing): the baselines are accurate on most of the lung but leave large regions out, which dominates the worst-case distance. General segmentation models, even when trained on pathological CT, still decide from appearance, and more training data does not fix this (VISTA3D does worse than TotalSegmentator). Closing improves the surface but cannot recreate missing regions, and Post-DAE recovers lesions but over-segments, since it has no anatomical anchor. The deterministic U-Net has all the inputs of LungMend plus the CT, so it isolates the diffusion step: when several completions are plausible, a deterministic model returns a single estimate and loses the cavities, whereas diffusion samples plausible completions and averages them.
blocks.zh: 与基线的比较。 LungMend是表1每个公尺上最好的方法,HD95的比值最大(5.5毫米对最强基线的22.9毫米,R231+闭合):大部分肺部的比值是准确的,但省略了大片区域,这支配了最差的距离. 普通分解模型,即使接受过病理CT的训练,仍然从外表上决定,更多的训练数据并不能解决这个问题(VISTA3D比TotalSectionator更糟糕). 关闭会改善表面,但无法再产生缺失区域,DAE后会恢复损伤但分数过多,因为它没有解剖锚. 确定型U-Net拥有LungMend和CT的所有输入,因此它隔离了扩散步骤:当几个完成是可信的时,一个确定型模型返回一个单一的估计数并失去腔,而扩散样品则可能完成并平均。

blocks.en: Number of samples and inference time. We tested several values of N N and chose N = 5 N{=}5 : with fewer samples the averaged map is sparse and unstable across runs, while beyond 5 5 we observed no noticeable change. The cost grows linearly with N N , but the samples are independent and can run in parallel on the GPU, so N = 5 N{=}5 remains practical as a one-off post-processing step per scan.
blocks.zh: 样本数量和推断时间。 我们测试了 N 的 数 个数值 , 选择 N = 5 N = 5 N = 5 : 样本较少, 平均地图稀少,而且不稳定, 而超过 5 个, 我们观察到没有明显的变化。 成本与N N 呈线性增长,但样本是独立的,可以平行运行在GPU上,因此N = 5 N{=}5作为每次扫描的一次性后处理步骤仍然实用.

blocks.en: Ablation. The ablation (Table 2 , single runs) shows that the information given to the model matters more than architectural choices. Bone conditioning helps where the mask alone leaves a missing region ambiguous, and pathology-mimicking corruptions are the condition for transfer: a model trained on random blobs loses the most lesion recall, because a healthy-only prior is useful only if the simulated failures resemble the real ones. Latent diffusion on the SDT beats voxel-space diffusion and binary masks. The medial and leak corruptions and the conditioning dropout have a clear effect here. At inference, guidance and averaging reduce the variability between samples, and a single sample is already competitive.
blocks.zh: 纵横. 膨胀(表2,单跑)表明提供给模型的信息比建筑选择更重要. 骨质调理有助于将面具留下一个缺失区域模糊不清的地方,而病理学模仿的腐败是转移的条件:一个在随机blobs上受过训练的模型失去了最痛苦的记忆,因为只有在模拟失败与真实失败相似的情况下,只有健康的前科才有用。 在SPD上的Lentental扩散会击败voxel-space扩散和二进制面具. 调解和泄密的腐败 和条件性退赛在这里有明显的效果。 推论,指导和平均可以减少样品之间的变异性,单一样品已经具有竞争力。

blocks.en: Qualitative results. Fig. 2 compares LungMend with R231 + closing on cases selected by the volume LungMend adds. The added regions are the large cavities and consolidations on the diseased side; further examples on Avicenne scans are in Fig. 2 b and in the repository.
blocks.zh: 定性结果. 图2 将LungMend与R231+对LungMend增量所选择的病例进行对比. 新增区域是病区一侧的大腔和整合区;关于Avicenne扫描的进一步例子见图2b和存放处。

blocks.en: Limitations. A healthy prior may over-complete lungs with genuine volume loss (fibrotic retraction, destroyed lung), so the uncertainty map should be read together with the input mask. The gain depends on corruptions that resemble real failures, and the 128 3 128^{3} resolution limits precision near the hilum. Lesion recall depends on the DeepPulmo labels, and the expert slices cover only part of the lung.
blocks.zh: 限制。 健康的先天性肺可能因体积损失(纤维退缩,肺部损毁)而过于完整,因此不确定性图应与输入罩一起读. 收益取决于类似于真正失败的腐败,128 3 128^{3}分辨率限制在丘陵附近精确度. Lesion recall依赖于DeepPulmo标签,专家切片只覆盖部分肺部.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented LungMend, a post-processing model that corrects lung masks in severe TB CT using only healthy anatomy. A latent diffusion prior trained on healthy lungs, together with a corruption model that reproduces the failure modes of texture-based segmenters and a bone-anchored condition, recovers cavities and consolidations that R231 excludes, without any pathological training data or CT intensities. Repeated sampling also provides an uncertainty map that shows which regions of the corrected mask were reconstructed rather than kept from the input.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了LungMend,一种后处理模型,它只使用健康的解剖学来矫正重度肺结核CT中的肺罩. 在健康肺上接受过潜在传播培训,加上一种腐败模式,即复制以纹理为基础的支架的衰竭模式和一种骨梗疾病,恢复了R231所排除的腔腔和巩固,而没有任何病理训练数据或CT强度。 重复采样还提供了一张不确定的地图,该地图显示经更正的面具的哪个区域是重建的,而不是不输入的。
